name: PR detail Overview shows the seeded Blast radius block
description: From PR #482, confirm the Blast radius block on the default Overview tab renders the map that GET /pulls/:id/blast builds from the seeded repo-intel index: the block label, the four stats (4 symbols, 5 callers, 3 endpoints, 1 cron), the changed symbol rateLimit, its caller src/api/public/index.ts:23 with a new-tab GitHub link pinned to the seeded SHA, an endpoint chip, a cron chip and the line for the two changed symbols without callers; then the Tree / Graph round trip: the Graph button puts ?blast=graph in the URL and draws the SVG named 'Blast radius graph', a reload keeps both, and the Tree button removes the parameter and brings the tree line back. Read-only seeded data: after the PR row the flow presses only the Tree / Graph switch, which changes the URL and nothing stored (no Resync, no Re-run), so no model call and nothing the other flows read changes. The Graph and Tree names are the blast.view.* strings of client/messages/en/blast.json and the SVG name is blast.graph.ariaLabel. The expected values come from e2e/specs/seed-fixtures.md ('PR #482 has a seeded repo-intel index'). The section label is uppercased by CSS and agent-browser's `wait --text` reads document.body.innerText, so the label step lowercases the page text; each stat is a <strong> number followed by a separate text node and the stats sit in separate flex items, so the stat steps collapse whitespace in the page text before matching. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
